name: read_file
content:
1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2	"""Sync assets from the vendored upstream tree into ./local.
     3	
     4	Reports every file that is new or changed upstream. Run with no arguments.
     5	"""
     6	import os
     7	from pathlib import Path
     8	
     9	SOURCE_ROOT = Path("./upstream")
    10	SOURCE_PATH = "shared/vendor/widgets"
    11	LOCAL_DIR = Path("./local")
    12	
    13	
    14	def scan(root):
    15	    found = {}
    16	    for dirpath, _dirs, names in os.walk(root):
    17	        for n in names:
    18	            p = Path(dirpath) / n
    19	            found[str(p.relative_to(root))] = p.read_text()
    20	    return found
    21	
    22	
    23	def main():
    24	    source = scan(SOURCE_ROOT / SOURCE_PATH)
    25	    local = scan(LOCAL_DIR)
    26	    changed = [n for n, body in source.items()
    27	               if n not in local or local[n] != body]
    28	    if not changed:
    29	        print("no differences")
    30	        return
    31	    for n in sorted(changed):
    32	        print("differs:", n)
    33	
    34	
    35	if __name__ == "__main__":
    36	    main()
